what_this_is: the state of one relay round against its fixed task list, rolled up from the committed run records. Coverage unions across lineages; cost adds. Not a score, not a bill, not a grade.

round_state.what_succeeded_means: produced deliverable files. Nothing here has been graded.

duplication.why_coverage_does_not_add: a task two lineages both solved is one task of coverage and two payments of cost

cost.excludes: grading. This counts only the model calls that solved tasks.

ledger_cross_check.why_they_differ_at_all: the records carry a per-task figure already rounded to the millionth; the ledgers round once over the whole round. The difference is that rounding, not a disagreement about calls.
